pending_commit.commit_message: arc: networkd: Scope devices by guest. This patch scopes device discovery and related activities by guest lifetime events. Specifically, when ARC++/VM starts or stops. This is necessary in order to ensure the correct type of device is built (corresponding to the ARC guest). This is suitable to support ARCVM networking in the near term but will need to be revisited when additional guest(s) are added. This patch sets the stage for introducing ARCVM specific helper and configuration code. device: led: probe the maximum value of brightness from ectool Previously in led.py, we assume the maximum value of brightness from the 'ectool led <name> <color>=<value>' command is 255. The actual maximum value may be different, e.g. 100. Using value larger than the maximum value is an unspecified behavior. On eve, it modulo the input value by the actual maximum value. In this case, the result is unwanted. This CL probes the maximum value of brightness using 'ectool led <name> query'. Also 'ectool led <name> <color>' set the brightness to 255, which always fails on devices with range check, e.g. nami. This CL makes brightness in LED.SetColor equal to 100 if not specified. BUG=None TEST=py/device/led_unittest.py Change-Id: Ia57d9a2d4ae2a6f3fb1cba76d46723c0521b8612 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1686797 Tested-by: Cheng Yueh <cyueh@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Cheng Yueh <cyueh@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org>

vpd: Add '--raw' for parsing raw VPD contents The VPD kernel driver does not export key names with dot but we use it for manufacturing stage, where the userland 'vpd' can read and write. However, to parse boot time values efficiently, factory software startup will try to fetch these special values using kernel driver and fail to read correct values. As a result, we want the VPD userland driver being able to read the raw blob exported from VPD kernel driver, the 'ro_raw' and 'rw_raw' files. A new --raw is now introduced so the `vpd` utility can read a VPD key-value store without VPD headers, just like what the kernel driver provides. BUG=b:135048597 TEST=vpd -l --raw /sys/firmware/vpd/ro_raw BRANCH=none Change-Id: I83415e966ccf6ab878cc48a407ac20da99a9aa87 Signed-off-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1686805 Commit-Ready: Fei Shao <fshao@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Wei-Han Chen <stimim@chromium.org>

video: Add resolution constraint for video_ChromeHWDecodeUsed test. video_ChromeHWDecodeUsed.vp8.mse was regressed on multiple board. The root cause is that it does not specify resolution on source video's URL. And its source, crosvideo.appspot.com, now sweeps all video resolutions up to 3840x2160, which triggers some devices' hardware decoders' reject the task. By specifying resolution=1080 constraint, the regression will be fixed.
